Wildlife credits

A little more life in the village, thanks to these generous artists.

Squirrel

CC BY 3.0

Chipmunk by Poly by Google, used under Creative Commons Attribution 3.0.

Repacked as a self-contained GLB with unused resources removed. The original texture, geometry and silhouette are preserved. This model has no rig or authored animation; the tour adds subtle ambient motion.

Farm & forest animals

CC0 1.0

Cow, deer, fox, horse, donkey, sheep and pig by Quaternius, dedicated to the public domain under Creative Commons CC0 1.0.

  • Cow, deer, fox, horse & donkey Ultimate Animated Animals The original glTF downloads and their CC0 notice.
  • Sheep & pig Lowpoly Animated Farm Animal Pack · Sheep source · Pig source Creator's original CC0 publication

Repacked as self-contained GLBs with unused resources removed. Peaceful idle and eating clips are retained. Solid materials were consolidated into vertex colors and one drawable primitive, preserving the original colors, silhouettes, rigs, joint weights and transforms. Redundant animation keys were removed without approximation.

The models retain their own licenses, separate from Maeul's software license. The original creators do not endorse this project. Model adaptations are by the Maeul in the Sky contributors.
